$comment: Gzipped ceilings for each package's ESM entry, in bytes. CI fails when one is exceeded.
The point is not the absolute number — it is that a dependency or an accidental
re-export shows up as a red check instead of being noticed six releases later.
Headroom is deliberately modest (~10-15%); raise a budget in the same PR that
justifies the growth, so the increase is reviewed rather than absorbed.
